tagline: Counselling for steadier days and meaningful change.
description: Virtual counselling based in Vancouver, BC with Amanda Hecimovic, RCC — support for eating disorders, disordered eating, anxiety, depression, burnout, self-worth, and life transitions.
hours: Monday to Thursday, 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM

insuranceNotes: Payments are processed through Jane App by Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, Diners Club, UnionPay, Apple Pay, and Google Pay

Receipts are provided and can be used for reimbursement through extended health benefits. I do not currently offer direct billing to insurers. Coverage varies by plan, provider type, and province. I would encourage you to confirm details with your insurance provider before booking a consult or session

If you are not covered by a provider, or they are unable to cover the entire cost, receipts may be kept and filed as a medical expense on your taxes. However, this needs to be confirmed with your accountant or by contacting the CRA

externalLink.label: Book an appointment online
externalLink.description: Appointments are scheduled through Jane App. You will leave this site to choose a time and complete your booking.

bookSession.label: Book a Session
bookSession.title: Request a counselling session
bookSession.description: Are you an existing client? Send a session request here, or contact me by email or phone. I will follow up to confirm scheduling. If you are new to the practice, please start with a consultation.
bookSession.descriptionWithCalendar: Choose a session type and an available time from the calendar, then send your request.
bookSession.confirmationMessage: Your session request has been received. The appointment is not confirmed until the practice follows up.

consultationCopy.title: Start with a brief consultation
consultationCopy.description: A short conversation to ask questions, share what you are looking for, and explore whether we feel like it may be a good fit.

bookSession.consultationSuccessMessage: Thank you for reaching out. I will reply within the stated response time to confirm next steps.

calendar.availabilityHelpText: Available times are based on the public calendar and include a short buffer between sessions.

sessionTypes.label: Initial consultation - phone or virtual
sessionTypes.description: A brief, casual chat where you can learn about me, ask questions, and discuss why you may be reaching out for support. Phone or virtual: the choice is completely up to you, your comfort levels, and which mode may give you a better sense of how I show up in sessions. If we determine that I may not be the best fit, I can offer referrals that may be better suited to your needs

sessionTypes.label: Individual counselling
sessionTypes.description: Your standard counselling session length. A space set aside for you, where you decide how you'd like to use those 50-minutes. And if you don't know how you'd like to use them, we can figure it out together

sessionTypes.label: Extended individual session
sessionTypes.description: Sometimes, we need extra space to explore things in more depth and at a pace that honours what you're bringing into the room. Longer sessions can be used to facilitate deeper work, discuss complex concerns, or practice new skills without taking time away from sharing what's on your heart and mind

contactForm.disclaimer: Please do not put sensitive information in the message field. I will follow up with you via email or phone. If you are in a crisis, or need immediate assistance, please call 911 or go to the nearest emergency room.
contactForm.successMessage: Thanks for reaching out. I will follow up by email or phone within the stated response time.
